1.consolidated_definition: Casta de gallos famosos en San Juan por su linaje de lidia. Pertenecían a la traba de El Moro , castador y gallero cubano. Eran únicos en Puerto Rico.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Strain of famous roosters in San Juan known for their lineage in cockfighting. They belonged to El Moro's stable, a Cuban breeder and cockfighter. They were unique in Puerto Rico.
